about: Files moved here byte for byte from Trillion-X/trillion-rust at 5fbc2ff4b1bf16622e2472f0638db9f79da980e9 on the owner order (Nov 15 2026: anything that is not one of the five core jobs is a tool and leaves the engine; state is a tool). The engine storage of an account rows, the local account and local workspace, the copies between computers and their simulation, and the examples and ports that go with them keep their source paths under this folder. Each file names its source path and commit and the identity of its bytes there and here. Only the listed calls differ: this repository is public, so the person name, a home folder, the private notes path and two words a private source holds are swapped for made-up ones.

calls.means: A path into the maker private notes, named as notes/ instead.
The person is named as the person.
A real player folder name in a prove example, made up as Example Player.
A home folder in a test path, made up: the made-up name example.
A test table name a private source also holds, made up as deals.
